brief: Run the cooling fans continuously through the overnight period to aid thermal recovery, and treat the cooling control as one stage unavailable under MG-021 because the cooling fans failed to start on manual test at the control cabinet. Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure for this ageing unit under MG-023. Additionally, replace the leaking gasket, re-test the oil dielectric strength, and pump transformer oil to bring the oil level sight glass back above the minimum mark.
